verdict.rationale: The only usage-policy content in the evidence is the pricing-page licensing statement: open-weight models are Apache 2.0 for research/individual use, while commercial deployments need a separate Mistral license. That statement is itself hard to parse, since it pairs an Apache 2.0 label with a commercial-license requirement. On data handling, there is only an indirect signal: optional EU/US regional inference routes model execution to a chosen geography. Missing for 10: a documented prohibited-uses/acceptable-use policy, plain-language commercial terms for API use, explicit data-handling commitments (retention, training on customer data), and independent corroboration that the policy is clear.
